<div class="rt-lab" id="root-lab">
  <a class="rt-back" href="stat3003.html">← 返回 STAT3003</a>
  <div class="rt-intro"><div class="rt-equation">求解方程 g(y) = a² + y² + 2ay / (n − 1) − (n − 2) = 0 的根</div></div>
  <div class="rt-layout">
    <div class="rt-controls" aria-label="实验设置">
      <label>求根方法<select id="rt-method"><option value="bis">二分法 · 保留异号区间</option><option value="newton">牛顿法 · 沿切线求交</option></select></label>
      <div class="rt-pair"><label>参数 a<input id="rt-a" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.1" value="0.5"></label><label>参数 n<input id="rt-n" type="number" min="4" max="100" step="1" value="20"></label></div>
      <div class="rt-pair"><label>左端点 L<input id="rt-left" type="number" value="0" step="1"></label><label>右端点 R<input id="rt-right" type="number" value="100" step="1"></label></div>
      <label>牛顿法初值 y₀<input id="rt-start" type="number" value="20" step="1"></label>
      <label>停止容差<select id="rt-tol"><option value="0.000001">10⁻⁶</option><option value="0.001">10⁻³</option><option value="0.00000001">10⁻⁸</option></select></label>
      <div class="rt-presets"><button id="rt-original">课件区间 [0, 100]</button><button id="rt-near">根附近 [0, 10]</button></div>
      <button id="rt-apply" class="rt-primary">应用参数并重置</button>
      <p id="rt-error" role="alert"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="rt-main">
      <section class="rt-panel">
        <div id="rt-chart" aria-label="求根过程：横轴y，纵轴g(y)"></div>
        <div class="rt-legend"><span class="curve">函数 g(y)</span><span class="point">当前候选点</span><span class="aux" id="rt-aux-legend">保留区间</span></div>
      <section class="rt-stats" aria-label="当前计算结果"><div><span>候选值 y</span><strong id="rt-value"></strong></div><div><span>函数残差 |g(y)|</span><strong id="rt-residual"></strong></div><div><span id="rt-width-label">区间宽度 R − L</span><strong id="rt-width"></strong></div></section>
        <div class="rt-playback"><button id="rt-back">← 上一步</button><button id="rt-play" class="rt-primary">▶ 自动播放</button><button id="rt-next">下一步 →</button><button id="rt-reset">重播</button></div>
        <label class="rt-scrub-label">拖动回看 <input id="rt-scrub" type="range" min="0" max="0" value="0"><output id="rt-progress"></output></label>

</div>
